## Modules

- [Bandit](https://bandit.hexdocs.pm/Bandit.md): Bandit is an HTTP server for Plug and WebSock apps.
- [Bandit.HTTP2.Settings](https://bandit.hexdocs.pm/Bandit.HTTP2.Settings.md): Settings as defined in RFC9113§6.5.2

- [Bandit.PhoenixAdapter](https://bandit.hexdocs.pm/Bandit.PhoenixAdapter.md): A Bandit adapter for Phoenix.
- [Bandit.PrimitiveOps.WebSocket](https://bandit.hexdocs.pm/Bandit.PrimitiveOps.WebSocket.md): WebSocket primitive operations behaviour and default implementation

- [Bandit.Telemetry](https://bandit.hexdocs.pm/Bandit.Telemetry.md): The following telemetry spans are emitted by bandit
- [Bandit.Trace](https://bandit.hexdocs.pm/Bandit.Trace.md): **THIS MODULE IS EXPERIMENTAL AND SUBJECT TO CHANGE**

- Exceptions
  - [Bandit.HTTP2.Errors.ConnectionError](https://bandit.hexdocs.pm/Bandit.HTTP2.Errors.ConnectionError.md)
  - [Bandit.HTTP2.Errors.StreamError](https://bandit.hexdocs.pm/Bandit.HTTP2.Errors.StreamError.md)
  - [Bandit.HTTPError](https://bandit.hexdocs.pm/Bandit.HTTPError.md)
  - [Bandit.TransportError](https://bandit.hexdocs.pm/Bandit.TransportError.md)
